levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير
أبو حيان التيمي يحيى بن سعيد

notes: Two taḥwīl branches meet at Abu Hayyan (named in each): the shared tail «عن أبي زرعة، عن أبي هريرة» is written once after the second branch
«- واللفظ له -» is a remark on wording: left out
«أبو حيان التيمي يحيى بن سعيد» has no separator in the text: read as one name, not split (rule 9)
Bilal's answer sits inside the saying; the last link is Abu Hurayra, who relays the Prophet's words to Bilal
